fields.title: Match / match detail / sport record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). recordType discriminates: MATCH (fixtures and live rows), MATCH_DETAIL (meta + incidents + statistics + lineups + head-to-head), SPORT (reference mode). Friendly field names are derived on top of Flashscore's own two-letter keys; the untouched upstream record always ships alongside them under _raw, because the upstream key set is undocumented and changes without notice.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The sport/day/match input that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-feed, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

matchId.title: Match ID
matchId.description: Flashscore's 8-character match ID. Feed this back into 'match' mode for full detail.

matchUrl.title: Match URL
matchUrl.description: Public flashscore.com page for the match.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country or region of the tournament, from the tournament header record.

tournament.title: Tournament
tournament.description: Tournament label as published, e.g. 'ENGLAND: Premier League'.

tournamentStageId.title: Tournament stage ID
tournamentStageId.description: Identifier for the season/stage the match belongs to.

homeTeam.title: Home team
homeTeam.description: Home team (or first competitor in individual sports).

awayTeam.title: Away team
awayTeam.description: Away team (or second competitor in individual sports).

homeScore.title: Home score
homeScore.description: Absent before kick-off - an unstarted match has no score key at all, which is deliberately not collapsed into 0.

awayScore.title: Away score
awayScore.description: Absent before kick-off, same as homeScore.

score.title: Score
score.description: Convenience 'home-away' string, present only when both scores exist.

status.title: Status
status.description: SCHEDULED | LIVE | FINISHED, mapped from the coarse status key. UNKNOWN when upstream sends a value outside that set.

statusCode.title: Status code (raw)
statusCode.description: Fine-grained upstream status code. Values observed include 1, 3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 38 and 45; the full enumeration is not published upstream, so it ships raw rather than guessed.

winner.title: Winner
winner.description: HOME | AWAY | DRAW, present only once the match is decided.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description: Kick-off in UTC ISO 8601, converted from the upstream epoch.

finishedAt.title: Finished at
finishedAt.description: When the match ended, when upstream published it.

statistics.title: Statistics (match mode)
statistics.description: List of {period, statId, name, home, away}. Football includes expected goals (xG), ball possession, shots, big chances and corners; other sports return their own set.

incidents.title: Incidents (match mode)
incidents.description: List of {stage, minute, player, side, incidentTypeId, note, _raw}. Incident type IDs are undocumented upstream and ship raw.

lineups.title: Lineups (match mode)
lineups.description: Decoded lineup feed blocks: formation, starting players, bench and ratings when published.

headToHead.title: Head-to-head (match mode)
headToHead.description: Decoded H2H feed blocks: previous meetings and recent form for both teams.

meta.title: Match meta (match mode)
meta.description: Upstream detail record: kickoff, finish timestamp and stage flags, passed through verbatim.

matchesToday.title: Matches today (reference mode)
matchesToday.description: How many matches that sport is carrying today, measured live at run time.

sampleTournament.title: Sample tournament (reference mode)
sampleTournament.description: First tournament seen for that sport today - evidence of what the sport ID actually contains.

isNamed.title: Is named (reference mode)
isNamed.description: Whether this sport ID has a verified human-readable name in the Actor's table.

_raw.title: Raw upstream record
_raw.description: The untouched decoded key/value pairs from Flashscore's feed, so nothing is lost when upstream adds keys this Actor does not name yet.
